title: Vision transformer on DNA-methylation images predicts cancer of unknown primary origin
summary: Trained on 8233 TCGA primary tumors in 18 organ classes, the model reached 96.95% accuracy on 394 TCGA metastatic samples and 96.39% (primary) and 94.37% (metastatic) in 995 samples from 20 external studies. Known-origin tumors serve as a proxy: no true cancer-of-unknown-primary cohort was tested, and the data are retrospective and public.
ai_technology: Vision transformer trained on organ-specific DNA-methylation images built from differentially methylated CpG sites

evidence.unknown: Retrospective public data; known-origin tumours used as proxy for CUP; no true CUP cohort; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Vision transformer on DNA-methylation images classifies origin of cancer of unknown primary
